[EN] Mission Orders

The ksharans in the Necromancer Tomb are threatening the entire area.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:471#105#ksharan battleragers}, {@LinkCreature:471#54#magisters}, {@LinkCreature:471#55#berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:471#56#myrmidons}, {@LinkCreature:471#5#destroyers}, and {@LinkCreature:471#6#defenders}.

Report to the nearest coordinator when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los ksharans en la Necromancer Tomb están amenazando toda la zona.

Mata a los {@LinkCreature:471#105#ksharan battleragers}, {@LinkCreature:471#54#magisters}, {@LinkCreature:471#55#berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:471#56#myrmidons}, {@LinkCreature:471#5#destroyers} y {@LinkCreature:471#6#defenders}.

Informa al coordinador más cercano cuando completes la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
